review_comments_data.body:
Ooh no, I don't like this @sanjayradadiya 

Sortable list is used in a range of places, including where `isGameControl` isn't present.

I know it's an optional prop - but I'd rather not see it here.

I don't know what the alternatives are, but I _guess_ `canDelete` callback could be provided that return true/false on if the row can be deleted.  It would popup the warning message if it receives a `gameControl` user, and return false.

Or, `maybe` this isn't needed, and we just access `isGameControl` from the item.

issues.title: Need flag to assign a role as `Game Control` able to step forward
issues.body:
We have an `isGameControl` flag in the wargame to show which role can move the game forward.

We can't set this from the admin pages. It's `probably` another toggle on `roles`.

comments.body:
It's this property that we need to control:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/132012919-acea20fe-b5df-45aa-8b77-aa5f70733537.png)

I propose we only show the toggle for roles if force has `isUmpire` ticked.
As a first step for this, we should manually insert the value for `Game Control` on `EXCON` - directly into the database

> We have an `umpire` flag in the wargame to show which role can move the game forward.
> 
> We can't set this from the admin pages. It's `probably` another toggle on `roles`.

Confirm few things.
1. umpire flag no changes required for existing? or Should i remove it and move to point no. 2?
2. new umpire flag with each role which is mentioned in attachment and it will store in database.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16476120/132641563-1e5eb648-eb97-467b-8ff7-4f3e4724db8f.png)

> As a first step for this, we should manually insert the value for `Game Control` on `EXCON` - directly into the database

isUmpire flag should be set from database for  Role `Game Control` on force `EXCON`?

> It's this property that we need to control:
> ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/132012919-acea20fe-b5df-45aa-8b77-aa5f70733537.png)
> 
> I propose we only show the toggle for roles if force has `isUmpire` ticked.

this for toggle should be display only if role has isUmpire flag set.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16476120/132642378-1266238a-3b89-4cd2-886e-5ed677223c97.png)

Sorry if it's confusing @sanjayradadiya 

Correct - the boolean is `isGameControl`, not `umpire` - my mistake.  So we need to add a `Game Control` toggle to the `Role` if the current force has `isUmpire` ticked.

I suggest you use the `control-tower` icon from Font-Awesome, with a tooltip of `Game Control`.

> only if role has isUmpire flag set.

no, only if `force` has `isUmpire` flag set:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/132653780-9b21db1d-d7c3-4e72-a20d-8b8e3dd2f021.png)
@sanjayradadiya  - could you update me on where you've got with this, please?
